speaker: Away Fan
content:
HOLD UP THERE, MATE!!! You've got some NERVE talking about RESPECT when you're clearly DISMISSING the EFFORT and QUALITY of my lads at INTER!!! Listen here, PSG may have managed to SQUEEZE out a win, but that DOES NOT diminish the POWERHOUSE performance from INTER!!!

You speak of EFFECTIVE EXECUTION as if PSG were some kind of MAESTROS on the field!!! Have you forgotten that INTER had them on the BACKFOOT for a good chunk of the match?! The possession statistic is NOT just a NUMBER, it's a reflection of DOMINANCE, and my boys DEFINITELY dominated that match!!

And if we're talking about performances, DON'T YOU DARE dismiss Lukaku!!! He may have been 'CONTAINED', as you put it, but even under that kind of PRESSURE, he FIGHTS like a WARRIOR, showing a DEDICATION and RESILIENCE that should be ADMIRED!!!
